identified_issues: Violation of deterministic state-machine progression via retroactive state manipulation (chronology laundering)
Failure of pre-trade risk-gate enforcement prior to order dispatch and market execution
Compromised audit trail integrity through direct retroactive mutation of trade_audit_ledger timestamps and compliance verdicts
evidence: Order ORD_99182 initiated at 10:00:00.100 and filled at 10:00:00.120 prior to risk evaluation
Risk compliance evaluation occurred post-execution at 10:00:00.250 as recorded by evaluated_at telemetry
Compliance reporting script executed an UPDATE statement backdating risk_verified_at to 10:00:00.095 and falsifying compliance_verdict to PRE_TRADE_APPROVED
recommended_action: Refactor trade workflow to enforce a synchronous pre-trade blocking gate that prevents order submission before risk engine sign-off; convert trade_audit_ledger to an immutable, append-only log with cryptographic timestamp verification to prevent retroactive modifications.
